components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Note green with white text for supporting actions, keeping gold rare.

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #b9cfc2; border-radius: 6px; background: #f6faf7; color: #1a1f1c; font-family: Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #d6e5dc; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d3b2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input

components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #b9cfc2; border-radius: 6px; background: #f6faf7; color: #1a1f1c; caret-color: #0d3b2e; font-family: Geist, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4a5a52; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0d3b2e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0d3b2e; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #a4262c; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Green-ground nav row with icon, label and pending-count chip; active state is a raised green, not gold.
components.html: Overview4Stations
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 216px; padding: 12px; background: #0d3b2e; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-family: Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #cfe3d8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item span { flex: 1; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(23,80,63,0.6); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; } .ds-nav-active { background: #17503f; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-chip { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: #cfe3d8; color: #0d3b2e; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Badge

components.name: Thread
components.description: Signature: a green hairline carrying one notch per pending item, colored by kind. Unbroken when the queue is clear.
components.css: .ds-thread { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 320px; height: 32px; background: #f6faf7; } .ds-thread-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #0d3b2e; } .ds-thread-notches { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding-right: 12px; background: #f6faf7; } .ds-notch { width: 6px; height: 28px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-notch-danger { background: #a4262c; } .ds-notch-ok { background: #17503f; } .ds-notch-warn { background: #7a5200; }

narrative.overview:
The admin desk is dressed like banknote security print: a deep note-green sidebar, celadon paper for the page, ink for text, engraved hairline rules for every divider, and foil gold as the single mark of "you can press this". The signature is the thread on the Overview: a 2px green line carrying one notch per pending item (flagged reports red, suggestions green, pin reviews amber). Clearing the queue closes the thread into an unbroken line. It replaces the category default of grey sidebar over stat cards.

Density is operator-grade: plain, fast tables, 14px body, 36px controls, tabular figures everywhere. Nothing is decorative; depth comes from tone (card paper on celadon) and 1px rules, not shadows. The world is light only (color-scheme: light, data-theme="light" forced by AdminRoot).
keyCharacteristics: Green ground (sidebar), celadon page, card-paper surfaces, 1px green-tinted rules.
Gold is rationed: pressable primary actions, the new-row tint, selection highlight, and focus rings on dark ground.
One family (Geist) plus Geist Mono for ids; tabular numerals on by default.
Radius 6px on controls, 8px on cards and dialogs.
Flat at rest; soft shadow only on floating layers (dialog, drawer, toast).

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Gold (#c9a227) is for things that can be pressed and for new rows, always with ink text, never white. A gold element that cannot be acted on, or a gold button with white text, is a defect.

rules.name: The Prefix Rule
rules.body: Admin colors are adm- tokens only. Never reuse the driver app's tokens in admin screens, and never use adm- tokens outside admin and the kit.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight and size, not new faces. 700 titles, 600 controls and labels, 400 prose; no other family enters the admin.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, inputs and buttons carry no shadow. Shadow appears only when a layer floats above the page.

dos: Do use Foil Gold (#c9a227) with Ink text for the one primary action in a view, and for new or changed rows (Gold Wash #f3e7b8).
Do draw every divider as 1px Engraved Line (#b9cfc2).
Do build new admin screens from the kit in src/components/ui and the adm- tokens, in AdminRoot.
Do keep text AA on its ground: Ink or Mute Text on paper, Note Text or white on Note Green.
Do keep tabular figures on counts and tables, and Geist Mono on ids.
Do respect reduced motion (transitions collapse to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion).
donts: Don't use gold on anything that cannot be pressed, or pair gold with white text.
Don't put shadows on cards, rows, buttons or inputs; shadows belong to dialog, drawer and toast only.
Don't fill the active tab or nav state with gold.
Don't introduce another type family or dark mode in the admin.
Don't use driver-app tokens or styles inside admin screens.
Don't treat the legacy look of AirtimePayouts.tsx (behind an off feature flag) as part of this system.
